info.description: End-to-end tests: Keycloak OAuth2, gateway, RBAC/ABAC, CQRS, outbox + Debezium, saga, cache, resilience. See TESTING_GUIDE.md.

request.description: Unauthenticated endpoint used by Route 53 health checks.
Fails with 404 until the 'enterprise' realm is imported.
Run once. 409 means the connector is already registered.

exec: pm.test("201 created or 409 already exists", () => pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test("connector and task RUNNING", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.connector.state).to.eql("RUNNING"); pm.expect(j.tasks[0].state).to.eql("RUNNING"); });

RBAC: customer role. ABAC: tenantMatches (JWT tenant_id = body tenantId), riskBelow(70) (gateway score 10), inTimeWindow, locationAllowed (CloudFront-Viewer-Country=IN). Writes orders + 2 outbox rows in ONE transaction.

item.name: 2.2 ABAC deny - customer-a creates for tenant-b

request.description: tenantMatches() fails -> 403.
No CloudFront-Viewer-Country -> locationAllowed() fails closed.
Allowed: IN, US, DE, GB, SG (abac.allowed-locations).
Update needs ROLE_ADMIN, or ROLE_OPERATOR with riskBelow(50) and inTimeWindow.
Run after the saga settled (folder 04). Optimistic locking (@Version) bumps the version and an ORDER_UPDATED outbox row is written.

exec: pm.test("SHIPPED and version incremented", () => { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("SHIPPED"); pm.expect(j.version).to.be.above(0); });

request.description: One virtual thread per order, orchestrated with CompletableFuture on the batch executor.

exec: pm.test("5/5 succeeded", () => { pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(5); pm.expect(j.succeeded).to.eql(5); pm.expect(j.failed).to.eql(0); pm.expect(j.orderIds.length).to.eql(5); });
